title: Debounce Service State
description: Rate-limits a pipeline by suppressing values that arrive before a configurable cooldown has elapsed. (Runtimes: browser; IDs: hookup.to/service/debounce)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

cooldown.description: Minimum time between forwarded values, in seconds

reset.description: When true, clears the last-fired timestamp so the next value is forwarded immediately
